claim: P87 observable structured learning with a covered domain
review_kind: Separate-agent raw-source correspondence review within the same collaborative model session. No external referee independence claimed.
authorship: Reviewer authored none of StructuredLearning, StructuredRectangle or StructuredLearningCapstone. Reviewer requested explicit bundling of existing general geometric marginal/window consequences; final sources were then reread after the authors froze them.

claim_card.objects: A scalar observation process with the declared four-moment reference, fixed parameters a,b in [-1,1], actual valid true transition density1+a*s*u+b*s^2*L2(u), accessible recorded history and actual conditional law; the two prescribed scalar regressions, simultaneous confidence event and full outward rectangle at an arbitrary selected finite time.
claim_card.conclusion: One measurable event of probability at least19/20 contains the true parameter in every returned rectangle. If a rectangle has nonnegative sufficient density floor, every member has actual all-horizon probability laws on C. Every center inside has actual conditional and full-record TV bounds relative to every member; for strictly positive floor it also has the full geometric and uniform marginal/window bounds. On the event, the true transition kernel is literally the certified true-parameter member.
claim_card.hypotheses: Declared reference support/moments, actual Markov true-kernel density and its nonnegativity, literal joint process/history law and accessible signal relation, fixed |a|,|b|<=1, positive endpoint grid and prescribed confidence protocol. No sample independence, supplied confidence conclusion, known prelearning diamond, hidden state recovery or empirical verification of assumptions.
claim_card.boundary_cases: Time zero and arbitrary finite selection are included. Nonnegative zero floor provides validity and record error; strictly positive floor is retained for division/minorization marginal stability. Floor one is allowed. Empty rectangles outside coverage have no selected center; on coverage, true membership guarantees nonemptiness.

obligation_matrix.evidence: This structured example is autonomous with Unit actions. Stability is for actual completed scalar Markov kernels and their marginals/rolling windows; no stability for arbitrary full-history feedback or long likelihood-ratio products is inferred.

execution_evidence: This is raw-source review, not an independently repeated compiler run. Author reported all three frozen modules compile with warningAsError. Root cumulative fresh compilation, axiom audit, kernel replay and negative-control results remain separate required evidence. No historical checks are relabeled as fresh here.
strongest_safe_statement: The full conditional P87 statement is supported by the exact frozen sources under its stated process/reference/model/confidence assumptions. The certified law family is the autonomous structured scalar family, with separate deterministic validity and conditional statistical coverage.
out_of_scope: Empirically verifying that an unspecified physical signal obeys the declared density, reference moments or parameter model.
Inferring coverage from one seeded path or from mere nonrejection.
Learning an unknown dictionary, hidden predictive state or arbitrary outside-family process.
Replacing full-record TV by a uniform marginal bound, or claiming feedback-policy stability from an autonomous Markov theorem.
